cmd.help:
Help:
Available chat commands:
<color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD status</color> shows plugin infos
<color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD open</color> opens the plugin menu
<color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD help</color> shows this help

<color=yellow>Tip:</color> Bind the command <color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD open</color> to a mouse button or keyboard key.

service.restorer: Choose a damaged item from your inventory. Repair prices include a material contribution and service fee. Completion time is based on missing durability; completed items are delivered by mail.
service.augmenter: Choose an item that supports modifiers. Only the next enabled augmentation tier can be ordered; required materials, time and fee are shown before confirmation.

refund.pending: The selected item changed after payment. The refund requires administrator reconciliation.
